review_notes: Use native enum names for reviewed stored/default choices, repeated menus, ASCII character mode comparisons, packed choices, zero-based legacy modes and independent graveyard trigger flag domains. Each edited token has the same plain C int value; no other implementation tokens change.

Secondary menus, unsigned literal ranks, cancellation values, bit-clear masks, costs, target indices and unrelated reuse of result locals stay unchanged. Thawing Glaciers sentinel 66 remains numeric. Grindclock AI priorities are not mode choices.

Retain damage_effects MODE/GLOBALMODE and static_graveyard_abilities GT_LG declarations without artificial uses: the recovered bodies already express those decisions as descriptive booleans. MODE_FREEZE_WHEN_DAMAGE has no numeric execution site in the recovered body.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.

omission_notes: fabricate is an already-symbolic static helper with no other identifier reference in its translation unit.

The graveyard life-gain group is represented by return_grove/return_punishing_fire booleans; the damage global mode is represented by destroys_damaged_creatures. Their exact native enum declarations remain in source without artificial uses.
The native damage freeze-mode enum has no corresponding numeric execution site in the recovered body; its declaration is retained.
compiled_enum_verification.scope: Native source declarations and all emitted enum identities/values checked. No runtime-byte identity or gameplay-equivalence claim.
